title: Reading HTTP 304 Logs
reading_goal: I understand that 304 indicates a status related to the reuse of cached resources.
code: ::1 - - [28/May/2026 22:29:11] "GET /data/lessons/file.json HTTP/1.1" 304 -
question: What does 304 usually mean?
explanation: An HTTP 304 Not Modified response means that the server file has not changed since the last request. The browser can reuse the existing cache instead of fetching a new copy. If you see a 304 response, it means the cache was used; if you were expecting a new file, you should check the version value or the cache headers.
